answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Splitting into 9 separate vaults demands a separate funded lotus account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The haven explorer exposes the whole merge tree. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
